title: People list
summary: The owner's invitation list: an e-mail field, a role picker, « Inviter », and one row per person with « Retirer ».
purpose: The registry block's PeopleList mounted the way an app mounts it: in the kit's Sheet (bottom sheet on a phone, right sheet on a computer), no class on its wrapper but padding, with the role picker shown, over a fake Worker. At 390 px a 40-character address is cut with an ellipsis inside its row and never pushes « Retirer » or « Inviter » out of the screen; nobody invited and a refusal (« Seuls les propriétaires de l’app peuvent faire cela. ») read well too.
notes: « Inviter » is a kit button outside the sign-in block's own 48 px floor: it keeps the kit's 44 px on a phone. The e-mail field, the role picker, « Inviter » and every row's « Retirer » stay inside the screen, and neither the page nor the sheet scrolls sideways, with a 40-character address in the list. The address is the one that gives way (an ellipsis, its full text in the row's title).

flows.name: Open the list with a long address

steps.expect: The e-mail field, the role picker and « Inviter » are on screen, and each of the three rows shows « Retirer » in view; the long address is cut with an ellipsis.

until.390: count:people-row>=3 & inside:people-email & inside:people-role & inside:people-invite & inside:people-remove & height:people-invite>=44 & height:people-remove>=44 & fit:[data-slot=sheet-content] & fit:[data-slot=sheet-content] ul & eval:[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=people-row] span')].some(s => s.textContent.startsWith('beatrice.delacroix-harborfr@') && s.scrollWidth > s.clientWidth)
until.default: count:people-row>=3 & inside:people-email & inside:people-role & inside:people-invite & inside:people-remove & fit:[data-slot=sheet-content]

steps.expect: The person joins the list and the field empties.

steps.say: Tap « Retirer » on the first row
steps.expect: The first person leaves the list.
« Personne n’est encore invité. » shows and « Inviter » is in view.
steps.until: text:people-empty~Personne n’est encore invité. & inside:people-invite & inside:people-email & fit:[data-slot=sheet-content]

steps.expect: « Seuls les propriétaires de l’app peuvent faire cela. » shows under the form; « Inviter » and every « Retirer » stay in view.

until.390: text:people-error~Seuls les propriétaires de l’app peuvent faire cela. & inside:people-invite & inside:people-remove & height:people-invite>=44 & fit:[data-slot=sheet-content]
until.default: text:people-error~Seuls les propriétaires de l’app peuvent faire cela. & inside:people-invite & inside:people-remove
